DArcCurveNode
create divide dv int 10
divide min 0
divide max 1000000
divide storable 1
divide keyable 1
create radius r float 5
radius min 0
radius storable 1
radius keyable 1
create width w float 1
width min 0
width storable 1
width keyable 1
create startAngle sa float 0
startAngle storable 1
startAngle keyable 1
create endAngle ea float 45
endAngle storable 1
endAngle keyable 1
create offsetAngle oa float 0
offsetAngle storable 1
offsetAngle keyable 1
create outputMesh opm generic
outputMesh accepts mesh
outputMesh storable 0
add divide
add radius
add width
add startAngle
add endAngle
add offsetAngle
add outputMesh
affects divide outputMesh
affects radius outputMesh
affects width outputMesh
affects startAngle outputMesh
affects endAngle outputMesh
affects offsetAngle outputMesh
remakeCurveNode
create inputCurve in generic
inputCurve accepts curve
inputCurve readable 0
inputCurve writable 1
inputCurve storable 0
add inputCurve
create sampling s int 10
sampling min 4
add sampling
create curveLength cl float 1
curveLength min 0
add curveLength
create offset o float 0
add offset
create outputCurve out curve null
outputCurve readable 1
outputCurve writable 0
outputCurve storable 0
add outputCurve
affects inputCurve outputCurve
affects sampling outputCurve
affects curveLength outputCurve
affects offset outputCurve
